title: Emu Plains Market
summary: Monthly artisan market at Emu Plains Reserve Balnarring. For lovers of craft, design, vintage, music and food. Seasonal schedule October–April (day market 9am–2pm) plus June and August dates. Site of the Womin Djeka cultural festival. Volunteer-run community hub.
recurrenceNote: Monthly October–April (day market); June and August also listed; no July, May or September
accessibilityNotes: Grassed reserve; generally accessible; uneven ground in places
nearbyAttractions: Balnarring Village; Balnarring Beach; Merricks wineries
editorVerdict: Emu Plains is the artisan market that actually feels like the Peninsula: stringybarks, music, makers you'd buy from twice.
editorNote:
Emu Plains runs monthly at Balnarring's Coolart Road reserve, with a seasonal schedule that skips most of winter (October through April plus June and August). It is volunteer-run, craft-and-design heavy, and the kind of market where the food trucks are worth queueing for.

The move: get there by 9:30am for the food and coffee before queues set in, do a full lap, then walk over to Coolart Wetlands next door (it's right there) or push on to Balnarring Beach. Skip in midsummer if you can't handle heat: minimal shade once the sun is up.
